name: takedown-watch
description: Shortcuts for the whole monorepo. Run every command from the repo root: npm run <name>.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix web install && cd pipeline && python -m uv sync
scripts.site: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix web run preview
scripts.update: cd pipeline && python -m uv run tw crawl && python -m uv run tw export && cd .. && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.update:quick: cd pipeline && python -m uv run tw crawl --max-articles 20 && python -m uv run tw export && cd .. && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.crawl: cd pipeline && python -m uv run tw crawl
scripts.export: cd pipeline && python -m uv run tw export
scripts.archive: cd pipeline && python -m uv run tw archive
scripts.stats: cd pipeline && python -m uv run tw stats
scripts.discover: cd pipeline && python -m uv run tw discover
scripts.test: cd pipeline && python -m uv run pytest -q
